I am examining the repository to identify which message broker the webhook delivery workers consume from and where the queue is declared.

Webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`). Worker goroutines are launched in `init()` within `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. NATS and RabbitMQ are not used.
I'll confirm how webhook workers get jobs and whether NATS or RabbitMQ is involved.
The webhook delivery workers do not consume from NATS or RabbitMQ. They use an in-process buffered channel instead.

r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used; no external broker or queue is declared. Webhook workers consume an in-process Go channel `asyncPostQueue` (`chan *WebhookRequestPayload`, buffer 128) created in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. `init()` starts 4 goroutines that range over it and call `Post`; `PostAsync` enqueues and drops when the channel is full.
